cite.locator: Budget at a Glance, Transfer of Resources to States and Union Territories with Legislature, row I: Devolution of States share in taxes, Actuals 2020-21 column

notes: The Fifteenth Finance Commission made two awards and 2020-21 falls under the first of them — its own single-year report, with horizontal shares that differ from the 2021-26 award in every state. Both awards devolve 41 per cent of the divisible pool.
